instrumentation.debuggerPolicy: Debugger-enabled build pinned; debugger remains inactive for M0 boot smoke. Later use must be bounded by a recorded experiment.

graphics.guestMode: VESA mode 0x69 as reported by the frozen DOSBox-X log
graphics.viewport: 640x480 centered, no crop or letterbox inside the logical surface

audio.device: Sound Blaster 16 with Nuked OPL emulation

input.sampling: Digital PC/AT make/break state; one snapshot per future tested game tick. Tick rate remains uncertain in M0 and no wall-clock key repeat is accepted as evidence.

timing.wallClockPolicy: Cold boot is marker-driven, not duration-driven; harness timeout is only a 30-second failure bound.
timing.tickAssumption: uncertain: DOSBox-X title reports approximately 29 FPS during the observed start surface; this is not promoted to a game tick rate.
timing.pausePolicy: uncertain and deferred until a controlled executable experiment

deterministicStart.archiveMount: authoritative ZIP mounted C: read-only, then DOSBox-X secure mode
deterministicStart.guestInput: all actions false; empty M0 boot tape

demoStart.definition: First 640x480 surface submission after DOS4GW execution and the guest VESA mode 0x69 reset.

bootComplete.definition: The m0-demo-start-v1 event has been reduced from the frozen emulator log; the harness may stop without applying guest input.

demoComplete.definition: First complete 640x480 frame after the level-completion transition has replaced the active level presentation and action input is no longer consumed by level play.
demoComplete.freezeRule: This operational boundary is frozen now; its concrete trace signature must be tested on the completion path before candidate gameplay acceptance.

limitations: DOSBox-X timing and rasterization are implementation-specific and are not original-hardware ground truth.
M0 does not determine the game tick rate, pause policy, or the concrete completion-marker trace signature.
Host audio is muted during the boot smoke; guest audio hardware configuration is frozen but waveform output is not tested.
No LEVEL2.PHD semantic analysis or broad executable reverse engineering was performed.
